title: da-bar/wgpa pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input: one row per genome pair (target and query FASTA, optionally a precomputed alignment)

id.errorMessage: Pair id must be provided, must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', and cannot be 'genomes' or 'pipeline_info' (in any case), which are output folders of the pipeline

target.errorMessage: Target FASTA must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fa', '.fasta' or '.fna', optionally followed by '.gz'

query.errorMessage: Query FASTA must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fa', '.fasta' or '.fna', optionally followed by '.gz'

preset.errorMessage: Preset must be one of 'near', 'medium' or 'far', or left empty to use --preset

alignment.errorMessage: Alignment must be a MAF or PSL file of the query aligned to the target, with extension '.maf' or '.psl', optionally followed by '.gz', and cannot contain spaces; leave it empty to align the pair with LAST
